title: JSON query output
goal: apg query gains a --json output mode: results as a JSON array of objects keyed by column name, CSV unchanged

body: apg query accepts a --json flag. When set, query results print as a JSON array of objects, one per row, keyed by column name (string-typed cell values, matching CSV semantics).

title: CSV path unchanged
body: Without --json, apg query prints the existing CSV output (header row + rows) exactly as before — no regression.

name: ResultPresentation
body: How query rows are presented to the caller: one row per result, cells as strings.

name: Rendering
body: The wire format the CLI renders: CSV (default) or JSON (--json).

name: cli-system
body: The apg CLI system: scan + query entrypoints.

name: cli
body: The apg command-line interface; the query subcommand lives here.
apg query --json "MATCH (m:Module) RETURN m.fqn" prints a JSON array of objects, each with the key 'm.fqn', one per module, parseable by jq.
Run jq on the --json output; run the plain query and diff the header+rows against the pre-change output.
No type-aware JSON (numbers/bools as native types), no --jsonl streaming, no JSON input mode.
